import numpy as np
x = np.array([[0., 1.], [1., 0.]])
z = np.diag([1., -1.])
hb = np.diag([0., .7, 1.3])
bx = np.array([[0., .23, .11], [.23, 0., .17], [.11, .17, 0.]])
bz = np.array([[0., .13, -.19], [.13, 0., .07], [-.19, .07, 0.]])
h = np.kron(np.eye(2), hb) + np.kron(x, bx) + np.kron(z, bz)
assert np.allclose(compute_moments(h, hb, 1.4, 12), target)

import numpy as np
p = np.array([1., .2, -.3, .1, .07])
q = np.array([1., .3, .4, .1, .02])
s = np.zeros(9)
for n in range(9):
    s[n] = (p[n] if n < 5 else 0.) - sum(
        q[j] * s[n-j] for j in range(1, min(4, n) + 1)
    )
c = s[:, None, None] * np.arange(16.).reshape(1, 4, 4)
assert np.allclose(fit_closure(c), target)
